code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Identify full-length border and the non-background object.
    counts={v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in set(sum(grid,[]))}
    wall=next((v for v in counts if all(x==v for x in grid[0]) or all(row[0]==v for row in grid) or all(row[-1]==v for row in grid) or all(grid[-1][c]==v for c in range(w))),None)
    bg=max(counts,key=counts.get)
    obj=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,wall)]
    if not obj or wall is None: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in obj),max(r for r,c in obj)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in obj),max(c for r,c in obj)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Shift the colored figure toward the solid border until it touches it;
    # mark the vacated boundary with an 8 stripe.
    if all(x==wall for x in grid[0]):
        d=r0-1
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in obj: out[r-d][c]=grid[r][c]
        for c in range(w): out[r1][c]=8
    elif all(row[0]==wall for row in grid):
        d=c0-1
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c-d]=grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h): out[r][c1+1]=8
    elif all(row[-1]==wall for row in grid):
        d=(w-2)-c1
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c+d]=grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h): out[r][c0-1]=8
    else:
        d=(h-2)-r1
        for r,c in obj: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in obj: out[r+d][c]=grid[r][c]
        for c in range(w): out[r0-1][c]=8
    return out
'''
